latest.title: How I created my own  hyper-personalized study workspace using Kiro, CDK, Cognito, Lambda, Dynamo, multi-user and productive.
latest.description: I wrote this article detailing how I built a serverless solution that completely transformed the way I consolidate high-level knowledge. Here is how I structured it: No passivity: I have to write the definition from my memory. On-demand mentoring: Drawing a blank? Just click once, and the AI ​​provides a contextual hint. Knowledge neural network: I can include references and connections. Instant feedback: Upon completion, the AI ​​ points out exactly what was missing.

latest.title: Confía en tu capacidad de aprender: hay una nube de oportunidades
latest.description: En tecnología nunca vas a saberlo todo, y está bien. Esta entrada es una invitación a confiar en tu capacidad de aprender, construir, equivocarte y seguir creciendo. Porque cada conocimiento puede transformarse en experiencia, cada experiencia en una oportunidad y cada oportunidad en un nuevo camino.

latest.title: The New Bottlenecks After Coding
latest.description: Now that writing code is cheap, the constraints show up everywhere else: deploy environments, code review, merge conflicts between parallel agents, org-wide architecture context, tests, specs, and monitoring. A walk through each one, why it binds, and the patterns and projects starting to loosen it.

latest.title: AWS Student Community Day Akure: Building Tomorrow Today
latest.description:
Organizing AWS Student Community Day Akure gave me the opportunity to lead the biggest student-led event on my campus and our first SCD in Akure. With over 300 builders in attendance, the experience taught me the power of teamwork, trust, and ownership in building a community.

In this article, I’ll share how we planned the event and the lessons I learned as an AWS SBG leader.
